title: Implement idempotent asynchronous billing event projection
summary: Implemented versioned, idempotent asynchronous billing webhook projection with provider event normalization, customer and checkout correlation, locked canonical subscription updates, timestamp and restrictive precedence ordering, retry/dead-letter/replay lifecycle, audit records, safe metrics, and entitlement invalidation only on canonical access changes.
